hero.heading: Four disciplines. One revenue system.
hero.lead: We don't sell channels in isolation. Storefront, lifecycle, and performance are engineered together so every improvement compounds against the same number.

disciplines.title: Shopify Plus Architecture
disciplines.desc: Custom theme and headless builds engineered around your catalog, markets, and merchandising logic — not a template.

disciplines.title: Klaviyo Lifecycle & CRM
disciplines.desc: Retention systems built on behavioral data: flows, segmentation, and SMS that compound revenue month over month.

disciplines.title: Conversion Rate Optimization
disciplines.desc: A continuous testing program grounded in analytics, session data, and statistically sound experiment design.

disciplines.title: Performance Engineering
disciplines.desc: Sub-second storefronts. We treat Core Web Vitals as a revenue metric, because that's exactly what it is.

engage.heading: How we engage
engage.lead: Most brands start with an audit, then move into a build or a growth retainer once the roadmap is priced.

tiers.title: Audit
tiers.desc: A two-week technical and lifecycle teardown with a prioritized, costed roadmap.

tiers.title: Build
tiers.desc: Full storefront architecture or replatform, delivered in six to twelve weeks.

tiers.title: Growth Retainer
tiers.desc: Ongoing CRO, lifecycle, and performance work with a dedicated pod.

cta.heading: Not sure which one you need?
cta.body: Send us your store URL. We'll come back with a short, honest read on where the biggest gains are.
